patientFeedback.title: What Our Orthopedic Patients Say After Recovery
patientFeedback.subtitle: Real mobility outcomes and post-surgery reflections from patients who regained an active lifestyle.

items.name: Marcus Bennett
items.quote: After tearing my meniscus playing tennis, other doctors recommended months of immobilization. Dr. Wilson performed an arthroscopic repair with microscopic precision. I walked without crutches on day 3 and was back on the court in 10 weeks with zero knee swelling.
items.outcome: 100% Knee Flexion • Returned to Competitive Tennis

items.name: Patricia Adams
items.quote: I had unbearable sciatica shooting down my right leg for over a year. The minimally invasive spine decompression done through a tiny 1-inch incision relieved the nerve pressure immediately. I was discharged the next afternoon and have been completely pain-free ever since.
items.outcome: Zero Sciatica Pain • Full Lumbar Flexibility Restored

items.name: Gurdial Singh
items.quote: Severe osteoarthritis made it impossible for me to climb stairs or play with my grandchildren. CareFirst's robotic knee replacement gave me a natural-feeling knee that bends effortlessly. The physical therapy team walked beside me every single day.
items.outcome: Stair Climbing Pain-Free • Daily 4-Mile Walks Resumed
